verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI documents a `scrapingbee crawl` command for same-domain or sitemap crawls, so crawling a whole site is a first-party capability. However, the HTML API is documented as scraping a single page URL per call, and the crawl feature gets only a one-line mention. missing for 10: a documented single API request or endpoint that crawls an entire site, details on crawl depth/limits and how content from all pages is returned, independent or hands-on corroboration of the crawl feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can crawl an entire website and get content from all its pages with one request

citations.quote: `scrapingbee crawl` | Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
